To regain payroll access after changing phones and being unable to complete MFA, you must follow the standard recovery workflow:

1.  Contact the internal Help Desk through an approved corporate channel [SEC-17::standard-recovery-workflow].
2.  The Help Desk will first verify your identity, revoke the unavailable authenticator, and then begin device re-enrolment [SEC-17::standard-recovery-workflow].
3.  Normal payroll access is restored only after you complete the new enrolment process [SEC-17::standard-recovery-workflow].

**Note on Deadlines:**
If you have a payroll submission deadline within four hours and cannot complete device re-enrolment, the Help Desk will create an urgent Payroll Support ticket. Payroll Support may assist with submitting the required change through an approved assisted process after independently verifying your request; however, this fallback does not disable or bypass MFA, nor does it restore portal access [SEC-17::payroll-deadline-fallback].

*This policy applies to situations where you cannot complete multi-factor authentication (MFA) due to a replaced, lost, stolen, damaged, or reset authenticator device [SEC-17::purpose-and-scope].*
